messages.content: You look at one picture with no other context and describe exactly what is drawn, like a careful field naturalist. Do not guess what was intended; describe only what is visible. description: a free paragraph describing the whole creature first. parts: every body part you see, one entry each (head, horns, ears, mane, legs, feet, tail, wings, gills, tentacles, shell, plates, scales, feathers, markings), with what it looks like and where it is. attached_objects: anything that looks attached to or sitting on the body rather than part of it, such as an object, an armor piece or a whole small animal; empty if none. animals: every real animal whose features you can see, as everyday English common names, at most four; include any animal that only one part resembles. Then count, looking carefully: separate_bodies: separate animal bodies or body-shaped objects in the picture, including any whole animal or animal-shaped object attached to or sitting on the main creature. heads: heads of any kind. walking_legs: legs the creature stands or walks on, including hidden ones you can infer. wings: wings of any kind. extra_limb_pieces: jointed leg-like, claw-like or tentacle-like pieces other than the walking legs and the tail. tails: tails of any kind (0 if none).

message.content: {"animals": ["bear", "beetle", "pillbug"], "attached_objects": [], "description": "A quadrupedal creature shown in right-side profile facing right, with the furry head, ears, legs and paws of a brown bear combined with a dark glossy segmented shell like a giant pillbug covering the back, neck, sides and upper legs, a single long curved black beetle-like horn on the forehead, and a small pointed segmented tail at the rear.", "extra_limb_pieces": 0, "heads": 1, "parts": [{"looks_like": "furry brown bear head with long tan snout, black nose and small brown eyes", "part": "head", "where": "at the front right end of the body"}, {"looks_like": "long glossy black curved beetle horn with a small inner prong", "part": "horn", "where": "on top of the forehead between the ears"}, {"looks_like": "small rounded furry brown bear ears", "part": "ears", "where": "on top of the head behind the horn"}, {"looks_like": "dark brown to black glossy segmented pillbug-like plates with thin tan seams, including large shoulder and thigh shields", "part": "shell", "where": "covering the back from neck to rear and wrapping around the neck, sides and upper legs"}, {"looks_like": "thick furry brown legs partially covered in dark glossy segmented armor", "part": "legs", "where": "under the body, two in front and two in rear"}, {"looks_like": "broad furry brown bear paws with long pale claws", "part": "feet", "where": "at the lower ends of the legs on the ground"}, {"looks_like": "small narrow pointed segmented tail tapering to a point", "part": "tail", "where": "at the extreme rear end of the shell"}, {"looks_like": "row of oval dark openings with tan rims on lighter segmented under-shell", "part": "side openings", "where": "along the middle side of the body between the upper shell and the belly"}], "separate_bodies": 1, "tails": 1, "walking_legs": 4, "wings": 0}
